title: Piercing Frame Solo MaxMakeup #026 (맥시멀리스트 얼굴 컷 · P25 집중형 · 맥시멀리스트 · 피부톤 에보니 브라운 · 재질 얼굴만 · 체형 latina curves · 금속 로즈골드 · 쥬얼리 JQ1 · 메이크업 코갸루)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult woman — DEEP EBONY BROWN SKIN, a rich dark complexion with warm brown undertones, late 30s goddess, latina curves physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, deep dark brown hair styled in elegant updo. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bright cheeky grin, a bold, commanding expression — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight pieces — a big rose-gold stud in the lobe, three smaller rose-gold rings above it, two thick rose-gold bars and two small rose-gold studs up to the top; one small rose-gold stud sits in the right ear; four rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small rose-gold rings pass through the left nostril and a thick rose-gold septum ring hangs below the nose; a rose-gold hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a rose-gold snake-bite ring beside it and a small rose-gold ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a rose-gold Medusa stud sits above the lips; a rose-gold labret stud and a small rose-gold ring sit on the chin; three small rose-gold studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small sapphires set into the metal. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears a single piece of gold necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and a single piece of gold hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
